name: Samba TV
why: Identifies what's on screen (including HDMI) to sell ad data.

name: TCL core service (TTVS)
why: Usage analytics, Samba hooks, Alexa and TCL firmware updates. Re-enable it before checking for a TV firmware update.

name: TCL Guard
why: Device-usage tracker. Some models restart it at boot anyway (stopping it fully needs root, which Liftoff never uses).

name: TCL launcher customizer
why: Puts TCL promos into the Google TV home screen.

name: TCL silent installer
why: Installs apps on its own at boot.

name: Play Auto Install
why: Pushes preinstalled promo apps back onto the TV.

name: Google TV (Freeplay)
why: Google TV store and free movies.

name: Google TV home screen
why: The stock home screen. Only disable after Liftoff is the Home app. On some TVs this (or the setup app) forgets saved Wi-Fi; have the Wi-Fi password or Ethernet ready.

name: Google TV setup / fallback home
why: Can grab the Home button back. Disabling it made one TV forget its saved Wi-Fi. Usually not needed: set-home-activity is enough.

name: Chromecast built-in
why: Casting from phones. Keep it if the user casts.

name: Google Assistant
why: The remote's mic button. Keep it if the user uses voice search.

name: TCL Assistant wrapper
why: Routes the remote's mic to Google Assistant.

name: Media
why: USB media player. Keep it if the user plays files from USB drives.
